answer: Here is a specific defense: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The network ties the timber to sunk effort, uses the wander as an corroborating signal, then requires a glacier before any payout.
